title: Inverted Illagers
description: Invert the textures of all Illagers and Witches
body:
Ever wondered what Illagers and Witches would look like… inside-out? This pack inverts the colours/textures of every Illager variant and Witch, making them look like they’ve stepped out of an alternate dimension, cursed, unsettling, and almost impossible to ignore. Your raids are now a trippy nightmare, you're welcome :)

Completely useless, but absolutely beautiful.
